name: Rockslide Plate
text:
This +1 resilient breastplate is carved from stone instead of being forged from metal.

Activate—Exhume 1 (concentrate, move)

Requirements You are buried under earth or rubble, typically because of a rockslide

---
Effect You slide through the material, moving 10 feet toward the surface.

---
Activate—Rockwave 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You are touching the ground

---
Effect You're carried forward on the crest of a wave of earth and boulders. You move up to 50 feet in a straight line, after which the rockwave disappears. You can move up or down, but if you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall. Any creature you move adjacent to during this moment takes 5d8 bludgeoning damage (DC 27 basic Reflex save save).
